魔防<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>
text.official_en:
The vihuela borne by Maria. Its somber
melody echoes up from the underworld
depths. Grants Res<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>
text.real_en:
A vihuela carried by Maria after she
fell into the underworld. Its dark melody
echoes from the depths. Grants Res<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>

text.jp:
古代技術で造られた特殊合金製の綱
魔法攻撃の命中時、<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>
text.official_en:
A cord made using an ancient alloy.
If unit's magic attack hits, inflicts Confusion
on foe. Trigger % = <#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>

text.jp:
冥界の昏き力を宿した舌
敵を倒した時、
自分のHPを中回復する
text.official_en:
A tongue imbued with dark power.
After defeating a foe, restores some
HP to unit.

text.jp:
冥界の昏き力を宿した鎖
魔法攻撃の命中時、<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>
text.official_en:
A chain imbued with dark power.
If unit's magic attack hits, inflicts Poison
on foe. Trigger % = <#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>

text.jp: 隣接する敵の幸運<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>
text.official_en: Inflicts Lck<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>

text.jp: 魔力<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>

剣・弓を装備中、
攻撃を命中させた時、
最低でも<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>
text.official_en:
When equipped with a sword or bow,
if unit's attack hits, deals at least <#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>

text.jp:
星の力を宿したアーク
魔防<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>
text.official_en:
An Arc imbued with the power of the stars.
Grants Res<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>

text.jp:
女神が護身用に忍ばせるアーク
追撃時、攻撃力<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>
text.official_en:
An Arc kept hidden for a goddess's defense.
Grants Atk<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>
text.real_en: An Arc carried secretly by a goddess for self-defense. When making a follow-up attack, grants Atk<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>

text.jp:
軍神のために造られたアーク
戦技での攻撃時、
攻撃力<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>
text.official_en:
An Arc crafted for the Bringer of War.
Grants Atk<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>
text.real_en: An Arc made for the War God. When attacking with a combat art, grants Atk<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>

text.jp:
各地の鉱山で産出される鉱石
抽出した物質を添加することで
武器の強化を行うことができる
text.official_en:
A common ore found throughout the
land. Known as a cornerstone in
smithing materials.
text.real_en: Ore produced in mines throughout the land. Extracted substances can be added to strengthen weapons.

text.jp:
天然で採掘される鉄鉱石のうち、
特に高品質なものを指す
炭素など不純物の割合が低い
text.official_en:
A high-quality ore, often found in iron
mines. Known for its low rate of carbon
and other impurities.

text.jp:
周辺の空気中などに漂う毒素を
吸収し、内部に固定させた鉱石
採掘には危険を伴う
text.official_en:
An ore that absorbs airborne toxins and
stores them inside. It can be dangerous
unless mined carefully.

text.jp:
常に風が吹き抜ける洞窟の奥で
形成されやすい珍しい鉱石
内部に風の力を封じ込めている
text.official_en:
A rare ore that forms in caves with
relentless air currents. It contains
the power of the wind.

text.jp:
よく雷が落ちる場所の付近で
形成されやすい珍しい鉱石
内部に雷の力を封じ込めている
text.official_en:
A rare ore that forms in areas with frequent
lightning strikes. It contains the power
of lightning.

text.jp:
海の近くにある洞窟などで
形成されやすい珍しい鉱石
海の神秘なる力を秘めている
text.official_en:
A rare ore that forms in caves near the
ocean. It contains the power of the sea.

text.jp:
日当たりのよい場所などで
形成されることがある珍しい鉱石
内部に太陽の輝きを秘めている
text.official_en:
A rare ore that forms in areas that are
frequently bathed in sunlight. It contains
the brilliance of the sun.

text.jp:
暗く静かな場所で
形成されることがある珍しい鉱石
内部に月の光を蓄えている
text.official_en:
A rare ore that forms in dark, quiet areas.
It contains the radiance of the moon.

text.jp:
暗く冷たい場所で
まれに形成される珍しい鉱石
青白い燐光を放つ
text.official_en:
A rare ore that occasionally forms in dark,
cold places. It glows with a pale-blue light.

text.jp:
通常よりも高硬度の水晶片
各地の洞窟で見つかることがある
刃に鋭さを与える特性を持つ
text.official_en:
A sturdy crystal shard, found in caves
throughout the land. Often used in
smithing to sharpen blades.

text.jp:
数千年の時間をかけて周囲の
魔力を取り込んで結晶化した鉱物
非常に特徴的な形状をしている
text.official_en:
A mineral that has crystallized by absorbing
magic over millennia. It is known for its
distinct shape.

text.jp:
木目のような模様をもった鉄鉱石
これを用いることで非常に高品質な
武器を制作することが出来る
text.official_en:
An iron ore with a wood-grain pattern.
Often used in smithing to forge
high-quality weapons.

text.jp:
銀白色の固く重い希少金属
極めて融点が高く、加工するには
かなりの鍛冶の腕が求められる
text.official_en:
A durable metal with a frost-like sheen.
With its high melting point, working it
requires incredible skill.
text.real_en: A rare, heavy, hard metal with a silvery-white color. Its extremely high melting point makes it difficult to work without considerable smithing skill.

text.jp:
極めて希少で神秘的な金属
もともとは隕石と共に地上に
降り注いだものという説がある
text.official_en:
An extremely rare, mystical metal. Some
theorize it originally fell to this world on
an ancient meteorite.

text.jp:
限られた場所でのみ産出する
非常に硬い鉱物。適当な金属と
打ち合わせると火花を発する
text.official_en:
A very durable mineral, only found in
specific places. It creates sparks when
struck with the right metal.

text.jp:
かつてウラノス山で発見された
経緯からこの名がつけられた鉱物
熱を感じる微量な気体を放出する
text.official_en:
A mineral named after Mount Ouranos
where it was discovered. It can determine
the sun's position.
text.real_en:
Named after Mount Ouranos, where it was
first discovered. Releases traces of a gas
that gives off a sensation of heat.

text.jp:
ネメアー大洞窟でのみ産出される
非常に珍しい鉱石
採掘には大きな危険が伴う
text.official_en:
A very rare ore found only in Nemea
Cavern. Mining it is extremely dangerous.

text.jp:
黄金色に輝く希少鉱物
魔力を内部に蓄える特性を持つ
神殿によって厳重に管理される
text.official_en:
A rare mineral with a gold sparkle. It can
store magic within itself and is strictly
regulated by the temples.

text.jp:
白く鋭い輝きを放つ希少鉱物
極めて硬く、強度が高い
神殿によって厳重に管理される
text.official_en:
A rare mineral with a pale sparkle.
Extremely durable and strictly regulated
by the temples.

text.jp:
希少な鉱物。戦いで斃れた後に、
冥界に辿り着けなかった魂の
成れの果ての姿とも言われる
text.official_en:
A rare mineral, said to be the lost essence
of a fallen warrior whose soul failed to
reach the underworld.

text.jp:
とろけるような脂肪と、濃厚で
旨味の強い赤身が特徴の肉
中型の雌の肉が最も美味とされる
text.official_en:
A rich, flavorful meat, known for its
succulence. It is widely agreed that
females produce the best cuts.
text.real_en: Meat with melt-in-the-mouth fat and richly flavored lean portions. Meat from medium-sized females is considered the finest.

text.jp:
強いクセと甘味を併せ持つ肉
丁寧に煮てアクを抜くことで、
驚くほど高貴な味に変化する
text.official_en:
A sweet, gamy meat. Simmering it well
brings forth a surprisingly refined flavor.

text.jp:
濃い血の香りが漂う黒っぽい肉
脂肪分は少なめで歯ごたえはあるが
噛み切りやすく食べやすい
text.official_en:
A dark meat with the potent scent of blood.
It is firm yet surprisingly easy to bite
through.

text.jp:
筋ばっており固めの肉質
よく塩を振ってから天日で干し、
保存食に加工されるのが一般的
text.official_en:
A tough, sinewy meat that is often
seasoned and sun-dried into jerky.
text.real_en: Tough, sinewy meat commonly salted generously and sun-dried into preserved food.

text.jp:
どっしりとした旨味の赤身肉
癖も変な臭いもなく、舌の上に
わずかに酸味と辛味を感じる味
text.official_en:
A richly flavored meat with no defining
odor. It has a slightly sour and spicy
aftertaste.

text.jp:
目に鮮やかな赤身ながら癖はなく、
極めて栄養価が高いとされる。
どんな料理とも相性がよい
text.official_en:
A nutrient-rich meat, known for its
bright-red color. Many agree it pairs
excellently with most dishes.

text.jp:
独特の匂いがあり野性味が強い
肉質は柔らかく、香草とともに
調理するのが一般的
text.official_en:
A tender, gamy meat known for its unique
aroma. It is commonly prepared with
fresh herbs.

text.jp:
脂肪分が少なくあっさりした白身
加熱し過ぎるとパサパサになり、
味わいを大きく損ねてしまう
text.official_en:
A lean meat with a fresh, airy flavor.
Overcooking it will likely drain it of
its flavor.

text.jp:
巨人が好んで持ち歩く骨付き肉
独特の保存方法の関係からか発酵
しており、特徴的な風味を持つ
text.official_en:
A bone-in meat favored by giants. It is
fermented, bringing forth a peculiar
and distinctive flavor.
text.real_en: Bone-in meat favored by giants. It has fermented, perhaps because of their unusual preservation methods, giving it a distinctive flavor.

text.jp:
硬い殻からは想像もつかないような
白く透明感のある肉は弾力に富み、
やさしく滋味あふれる味わい
text.official_en:
A white, translucent meat housed in a
thick shell. It's springy to the touch with
a hearty flavor.
text.real_en:
White, translucent meat inside a hard
shell. Surprisingly springy, with a gentle,
nourishing flavor.

text.jp:
可食部は意外なほど少ない
肉質は白っぽく繊維質で、一部の
甲殻類によく似た味わいがする
text.official_en:
A pale, fibrous meat with a similar flavor
to crustaceans. Surprisingly few parts of
this animal are edible.

text.jp:
弾力のあるしっかりとした肉質で
噛めば旨味が染み出してくる
砂漠では貴重な蛋白源となる
text.official_en:
A firm, chewy meat with a deep flavor.
Desert dwellers see it as a valuable
source of protein.

text.jp:
ダグザ全土に生息する淡水魚
小ぶりでやや平たい身体を持つ
骨が柔らかくそのまま食べられる
text.official_en:
A common Dagdan freshwater fish. It is
small and flat with bones that can be
removed or eaten whole.
text.real_en: A small, somewhat flat freshwater fish found throughout Dagda. Its bones are soft enough to eat without removing them.

text.jp:
主にバアル湖に生息する淡水魚
寿命が長くかなりの大きさにまで
成長する。肉は甘みがあり美味
text.official_en:
A common freshwater fish of Lake Baal
known for its notable lifespan and size.
Its meat is pleasantly sweet.

text.jp:
神魚とも呼ばれる伝説の魚
特定の湖にのみ生息している
食べると身体が強くなるとも
text.official_en:
A legendary fish, also known as the divine
trout. It is said to strengthen the body
when consumed.
text.real_en: A legendary fish also known as the divine fish. Found only in certain lakes, it is said to strengthen the body when eaten.

text.jp:
外洋性の大型の肉食魚
身は肉厚でうまみが強く、
様々な形に加工され利用される
text.official_en:
A large, carnivorous open-sea fish. Its meat
is thick and rich, and can be prepared in
many ways.

text.jp:
外洋性の大型の肉食魚
特定の海域にのみ生息している
頭に特徴的な模様がある
text.official_en:
A large, carnivorous open-sea fish known
for the pattern on its head. It only resides
in certain areas.

text.jp:
美しい黄金色の体色を持つ魚
淡水、海水に関わらず生息できる
味は甘みがあり、非常に上品
text.official_en:
A sweet fish with beautiful, golden scales.
It can survive in both freshwater and
saltwater habitats.

text.jp:
広い範囲に分布する白い魚
淡水、海水に関わらず生息できる
不思議なほど身の塩味が強い
text.official_en:
A salty fish with silvery-white scales. It
can survive in both freshwater and
saltwater habitats.
text.real_en: A white fish found across a wide area, able to live in both fresh and salt water. Its flesh is strangely salty.

text.jp:
比較的流れの緩やかな場所に
隠れるように生息する淡水魚
非常に堅い鱗を持つのが特徴
text.official_en:
A freshwater fish known for its incredibly
thick scales. It hides in areas with relatively
low currents.

text.jp:
非常に栄養価の高い希少な魚
荒磯を好んで住処にすることが
多いと言われている
text.official_en:
A rare fish with extremely high nutritional
value. It prefers to live in rough seas.

text.jp:
リル海に広く分布している魚
身体は小さいが、性格は獰猛で
漁師の網を食い破る厄介者
text.official_en:
A fish found widely in the Lir Sea. It is
small but fiercely aggressive, often tearing
through fishing nets.

text.jp:
大型で獰猛な魚。知能が高く、
集団で狩りをすることもある
捕獲が難しく希少価値が高い
text.official_en:
A large, ferocious fish known to hunt in
packs. It is valuable but intelligent enough
to avoid capture.
text.real_en: A large, ferocious and intelligent fish that sometimes hunts in groups. Difficult to catch and therefore highly prized.

text.jp:
非常に大型で鋭い嘴を持つ
遠洋に生息し極めて力が強いため
捕獲は熟練の漁師でも難しい
text.official_en:
A deep-sea fish with immense strength and
a large, sharp beak. It can be incredibly
difficult to catch.
text.real_en: An exceptionally large, powerful fish with a sharp beak, found in the open ocean. Even experienced fishers struggle to catch it.

text.jp:
汚染に強く、どのような環境でも
生息することができる淡水魚
調理前に泥を吐かせた方がよい
text.official_en:
A resilient freshwater fish that can thrive
in polluted habitats. Best purged of mud
before cooking.

text.jp:
ラドン湖などの大きな湖に
広く生息している淡水魚
臭みが強く、調理には工夫が必要
text.official_en:
A freshwater fish found in large lakes.
It has a powerful odor and requires
expert preparation.

text.jp:
ごく限られた湖にしか生息しない、
非常に希少な魚。身の味は独特で
好きな者にとっては堪えられない
text.official_en:
A very rare fish found only in certain lakes.
Its unique taste can become addicting
for some.
text.real_en: An extremely rare fish found in only a handful of lakes. Its unusual flavor is irresistible to those who enjoy it.

text.jp:
リル海で獲れる魚。極めて癖の
強い味で、これをどう抑え込む
かが料理人の腕の見せ所
text.official_en:
A fish found in the Lir Sea. Known for its
distinct flavor, it can only be prepared
properly by expert chefs.
text.real_en: A fish caught in the Lir Sea, with a very strong and distinctive flavor. A chef's skill lies in knowing how to tame that flavor.

text.jp:
非常に平べったい体をしており、
まるで盾のような形をしている
干物にしたものが珍重される
text.official_en:
A fish with a flat body resembling a shield.
Its dried form is considered a delicacy.

text.jp:
湖に広く生息している淡水魚
見た目が優雅で美しいことから
湖の女王とも喩えられる
text.official_en:
A freshwater fish commonly found in lakes.
With its elegance, it is often called the
Queen of the Lake.

text.jp:
寒流に乗って回遊する魚
味は癖が少なく、どのような
調理法とも相性が良い
text.official_en:
A migratory fish that travels along cold
currents. Its mild flavor is consistent
despite how it's cooked.

text.jp:
パンジャ海流に生息している深海魚
驚くほど身の脂が多く美味だが
食べ過ぎると豪傑でも腹を下す
text.official_en:
A deep-sea fish found in the Pasha
Currents. Incredibly fatty and delicious,
but fills the stomach quickly.
text.real_en:
A deep-sea fish of the Panja Current.
Delicious and exceptionally fatty, but
overeating can upset even a strong man’s stomach.

text.jp:
特徴的な姿を保った古代魚
湖などを生息場所としている
干物にすると奥深い味わいになる
text.official_en:
An ancient freshwater-lake fish with a
striking appearance. Drying it brings
forth a deep flavor.

text.jp:
海でも湖でも生息できる希少な魚
極めて深い場所に生息しており、
滅多な事では網にかからない
text.official_en:
A rare fish found in both seas and lakes.
Because it lives in extremely deep waters,
it is rarely caught.

text.jp:
限られた湖にのみ生息するという
幻の魚。月の夜に全身が
光輝くという伝説がある
text.official_en:
A mythical fish that only lives in certain
lakes. Legends spin tales of its radiant
glow on moonlit nights.

text.jp:
リル海に広く生息している
一般的な魚。よく海底に潜って
顔だけ出している姿が見られる
text.official_en:
A common fish found in the Lir Sea. It is
often spotted beneath the seabed, peeking
out curiously.
text.real_en:
A common fish in the Lir Sea. It often
buries itself in the seabed, leaving
only its face exposed.

text.jp:
ゾトー湖に生息している淡水魚
味は良いが傷みが早いため、
加工された状態で取引される
text.official_en:
A freshwater fish often found in lakes.
It spoils quickly, so it is typically sold in
a processed form.
text.real_en:
A freshwater fish found in Lake Zoto.
It spoils quickly and is usually sold
processed, despite its good flavor.

text.jp:
頭部にごつごつとした殻を持つ、
海底に生息する蛸の一種
煮て食べると非常に美味い
text.official_en:
An octopus that lives on the seabed and
has a sturdy shell protecting its head.
It is delicious when boiled.

text.jp:
全身が頑丈な皮で覆われた魚
無骨な外見をしており、その身は
淡泊ながら上品な旨味がある
text.official_en:
A rugged fish known for its thick exterior.
Its flesh has a light, elegant flavor.

text.jp:
中型で短い嘴を持つ回遊魚
筋肉質な身には優しい甘味があり
煮物や焼き物など料理を選ばない
text.official_en:
A migratory fish with a short beak. Its meat
is thick and sweet. It pairs well with
many dishes.
text.real_en: A migratory fish of medium size with a short beak. Its muscular flesh is gently sweet and suits any preparation, from simmering to grilling.

text.jp:
南部で多く栽培されている果実
果実を除き種を焙煎したものが
テフとして各地で取引される
text.official_en:
Berries widely cultivated in the south.
The seeds can be removed and roasted
then traded as coffee in various regions.
text.real_en:
A fruit widely cultivated in the south.
After the flesh is removed, its roasted
seeds are traded as Tef.

text.jp:
ダグザ全土に自生している果物
木の幹に小振りな果実が実る
ゴーシュの材料として利用される
text.official_en:
A fruit that grows wildly on tree trunks
throughout Dagda. It is typically used to
make ghosh.
text.real_en:
A fruit that grows on tree trunks
throughout Dagda. Often used to make
Gauche.

text.jp:
森林地帯などに自生する果物
果実は甘く栄養価が非常に高い
葉や茎の繊維なども利用される
text.official_en:
A fruit that grows wildly in forests. It is
sweet and highly nutritious. Its leaf fiber
can also be harvested.
text.real_en: A sweet, highly nutritious fruit that grows wild in forests. The fibers of its leaves and stems are also used.

text.jp:
乾燥地帯に自生する植物
実を脱穀したものが食用になる
風味は強く、土の匂いがする
text.official_en:
A plant that thrives in dry regions. With
edible kernels, it has a strong flavor and
earthy aroma.

text.jp:
広く利用されている穀物
生育には十分な水が必要なため、
大河の流域などで栽培される
text.official_en:
A widely used grain. It requires ample
water to grow, so it is farmed in areas
with large rivers.

text.jp:
乾燥に強く砂漠でも自生できる
樹上で乾燥された実は非常に甘く、
保存食として広く利用される
text.official_en:
A sweet, drought-resistant fruit that thrives
in the desert. It preserves excellently
when dried.
text.real_en: A drought-resistant tree that can grow wild in the desert. Its fruit dries on the tree, becoming very sweet and widely used as preserved food.

text.jp:
珍しいギンジの突然変異種
果実は鮮やかな青色をしている
ソウシュの材料として利用される
text.official_en:
A rare, mutant species of ginji. This variant
is bright blue and is used as an ingredient
for shosh.
text.real_en:
A rare blue mutation of Ginji fruit.
Used as an ingredient in Soush.

text.jp:
比較的穏やかな気候を好んで
自生する植物。特徴的な四角い
形の花が可食部となる
text.official_en:
A plant that grows in relatively mild
climates. The edible part is its distinct,
square-shaped flower.

text.jp:
南部で見られる植物。硬い殻に
覆われた果実は豊富な油脂を含む
殻は小物入れなどに加工される
text.official_en:
A southern plant with shelled fruit
containing oil. The shells are used
to make containers for small items.

text.jp:
ごく限られた場所にのみ自生する
珍しい香草で、葉や茎を利用する
甘く風味豊かな上、薬効が高い
text.official_en:
A rare herb cultivated for its stems and
leaves. It has a sweet, rich flavor and
high medicinal benefits.
text.real_en:
A rare wild herb found only in certain
places. Its sweet, rich stems and leaves
are prized for their medicinal benefits.

text.jp:
温暖で湿潤な環境を好む植物
収穫後の地下茎は保存性もよく、
食用として広く利用される
text.official_en:
A plant that thrives in humid habitats.
Its rhizomes store well and are a great
source of nutrients.
text.real_en: A plant that favors warm, humid conditions. Its harvested rhizomes keep well and are widely used as food.

text.jp:
主にソリダス地方に自生する植物
食用として利用する場合は、
花が咲く前に収穫する必要がある
text.official_en:
Primarily found in the Solidus region. It is
only edible if harvested before it blooms.

text.jp:
ごく限られた場所でのみ生育する
希少な植物。長く伸びた蔓の先に
大ぶりの果実が実る
text.official_en:
A rare plant that grows in specific areas.
It produces large fruit at the end of its vines.

text.jp:
乾燥した地域に自生する植物
上品な甘さと希少性から
高値で取引されることもある
text.official_en:
A plant that flourishes in dry areas. Due to
its sweetness and rarity, it can be traded
at a high price.

text.jp:
砂漠などで自生している植物
内部に大量の水を蓄えており、
これによって救われる旅人も多い
text.official_en:
A plant that primarily grows in deserts.
It stores enough water to save dehydrated
travelers.

text.jp:
火を噴くと形容されるほどの
強烈な辛みを葉に持った植物
希少な香辛料として珍重される
text.official_en:
A plant with leaves so spicy they are often
described as fiery. Highly prized as a
rare spice.

text.jp:
美しい植物だが強い毒性を持ち、
人間が食べる場合は入念な下処理が
必要となる。虫除けに重宝される
text.official_en:
A beautiful plant but highly poisonous.
Must be properly prepared before human
consumption. Useful as an insect repellent.

text.jp:
山岳などに自生している野菜
辛味の強い果実をよく乾燥させた
ものが料理などに利用される
text.official_en:
A pungent vegetable that grows in
mountainous areas. Its fruit is often
dried and used in cooking.

text.jp:
砂漠に自生している植物
葉にある棘を除去して利用する
繊維質で独特の辛味を持つ
text.official_en:
A fibrous desert plant that must have its
thorns removed before use. Known for its
unique, spicy flavor.

text.jp:
比較的場所を選ばず自生する野菜
実は小ぶりだが風味豊かで潰した
ものが料理の隠し味に利用される
text.official_en:
A plant that can grow almost anywhere.
Its fruit is often crushed and used as
accent flavoring.

text.jp:
キンバイの突然変異種
鮮やかな赤い花を咲かせる
種子は風味が強く珍重される
text.official_en:
A mutant species of the kimbai with vivid
red flowers. Its seeds are prized for their
potent flavor.

text.jp:
砂漠に自生する珍しい植物
刻んだ葉を香辛料として利用する
薬の原料として探す者も多い
text.official_en:
A rare desert plant. Its versatile leaves
can be used as spices or as medicinal
ingredients.

text.jp:
北部でよくみられる野菜
球形の赤い根の部分を食す
独特の辛味は加熱すると和らぐ
text.official_en:
A vegetable found in northern areas. Known
for its spherical red root, it loses spiciness
when heated.

text.jp:
高温多湿な地域を好む野菜
極めて辛味が強いため、収穫の
際に手が爛れることがある
text.official_en:
A vegetable that thrives in heat. Its
spiciness can even cause irritation
to the hands when harvested.
text.real_en: A vegetable that grows in hot, humid regions. It is so intensely pungent that harvesting it can leave the hands raw and inflamed.

text.jp:
大人の頭ほどもある果実
極めて香気高くほろ苦い味わい
皮も蜜漬けなどに利用される
text.official_en:
A massive fruit. It is exceptionally fragrant
with a slightly bitter taste. It is often
preserved in honey.
text.real_en: A fruit the size of an adult's head, intensely fragrant and slightly bitter. Even its peel is used in honey preserves.

text.jp:
ダグザ全土に自生する植物
様々な色の小振りな花をつける
基本的に丈夫で乾燥にも強い
text.official_en:
A common plant in Dagda, known for its
wide array of colored flowers. It is sturdy
and resilient.

text.jp:
標高の低いところに自生する野菜
確かな歯ごたえと苦みが特徴
精神を落ち着かせる薬効もある
text.official_en:
A bitter vegetable that thrives in low
altitudes. It is known to soothe the mind
when ingested.

text.jp:
広く自生している乾燥に強い植物
果実は食用となるほか、絞って
油に加工されることも多い
text.official_en:
A widespread, drought-resistant plant.
Its edible fruit is often squeezed and
processed into oil.

text.jp:
イチノミの突然変異種で、
ノーアの洞窟の北部にのみ自生する
幻と称されるほどに香り高い
text.official_en:
A mutant species of the wun fruit, only
found north of Nowah's Cave. Its exquisite
fragrance is legendary.
text.real_en:
A mutant species of the wun fruit, only
found north of Noah's Cave. Its exquisite
fragrance is legendary.

text.jp:
南部に自生する植物。果実は
甘酸っぱいが、発酵させた種子を
練りあげたものは高級食材となる
text.official_en:
A southern plant with sweet, sour fruit.
Paste made from its seeds is valued
as a luxury ingredient.

text.jp:
山岳地帯に自生する植物
美しい黄色い花が咲く
種子は香辛料として利用される
text.official_en:
A mountain plant with gorgeous yellow
flowers. Its seeds are often used as a spice.

text.jp:
ランバス地方に自生している植物
柔らかい新芽を摘み取り乾燥させ、
煎じた汁の風味を楽しむ
text.official_en:
A Lambath-region plant. Its tender new
shoots are dried and steeped to bring out
their deep fragrance.
text.real_en:
A plant native to Lambuth. Its tender
young shoots are dried and steeped
to enjoy their flavor.

text.jp:
標高の高い場所を好む野菜
実はほろ苦いが風味豊か
似た形で毒のあるニノミに注意
text.official_en:
A pleasantly bitter plant that thrives in
high altitudes. It is often mistaken for the
toxic tew fruit.

text.jp:
東部に多く生息する葉野菜
基本的に上品な味だが傷みが早く
鮮度が落ちると苦みが増す
text.official_en:
A leafy fruit commonly found in the east.
It has a refined flavor but spoils quickly,
turning bitter.
text.real_en:
A leafy vegetable native to the east.
It spoils quickly, becoming more bitter
as its freshness fades.

text.jp:
風通しのよい丘陵地帯などに
まれに自生する希少な木の実
滋養強壮剤として珍重される
text.official_en:
A rare nut that can grow in windy hill-lands.
It is highly valued as a nutritional tonic.

text.jp:
主にメリアス地方の平地に自生する
非常に特徴的な見た目の野菜
癖が少なくほろ苦い味がする
text.official_en:
A distinct vegetable that grows mainly in
the Melias-region plains. Known for its mild,
slightly bitter taste.

text.jp:
サラミス王国の特産品
美味だがアクが強く、食べられる
ようになるまでの工程が多い
text.official_en:
A specialty in Saramis. It is bitter, but
satisfying, and requires many steps
before it is actually edible.

text.jp:
カスタリア地方に自生する香草
刺激的な風味が食欲を誘う
食べ過ぎると臭いが気になる
text.official_en:
A fragrant herb from Castalia. It is delicious,
but consuming it in excess can cause the
body to smell.

text.jp:
アトラ山などで見られる植物
何度も繰り返し天日干しをして
ようやく食べられるようになる
text.official_en:
A plant found in areas like Mount Atla.
It must be sun-dried multiple times
before it is edible.

text.jp:
山間部に自生する豆の一種
栄養価が非常に高く健康に良い
発酵させて食べる地方もある
text.official_en:
A bean that thrives in mountainous areas.
Fermented in some regions, it is highly
nutritious.

text.jp:
バシテア地方でよくみられる香草
葉の部分のみを摘んで使用する
肉桂に似た高貴な香りがする
text.official_en:
An herb from the Pasithea region with
similar fragrance to cinnamon. Typically,
only its leaves are used.

text.jp:
南部地方で栽培される植物
ブレザラント王国の特産品
少し赤身肉に似た風味がする
text.official_en:
A plant cultivated in the south and a
specialty in Brezarant. It has a flavor
resembling meat.
text.real_en: A southern crop and specialty of the Kingdom of Brezarant, with a flavor somewhat like red meat.

text.jp:
カスタリア地方に自生する野草
観賞用としても利用される
花には強い防虫作用があるらしい
text.official_en:
A wild herb of the Castalia region. It works
well as an ornament or as insect repellent.
text.real_en: A wild herb from Castalia, also grown for decoration. Its flowers are said to have strong insect-repelling properties.

text.jp:
滅多に発見できない希少植物
頭をすっきりさせる効果があり、
偉大な賢者が愛用していたとも
text.official_en:
An extremely rare plant said to help clear
the mind. Legend says it was once favored
by a great sage.

text.jp:
ある地域でしか咲かない珍しい花
ヤーマン村で名産品として
販売されているものが有名
text.official_en:
A rare flower that only blooms in a certain
area. Famous as a specialty product of
Yaaman village.

text.jp:
特定の土地でしか根付かない木
揺らすと手に入る沢山の実は
トバリンの村で販売されている
text.official_en:
Nuts sold in Twalinn village, gathered
by shaking a variety of tree that only
grows in certain places.
text.real_en:
Nuts from a tree found only in certain
areas. Collected by shaking the tree,
they are sold in Tobalin Village.

text.jp:
バシテア地方の希少植物
口に含むと独特な清涼感を感じる
巨人の伝説にも登場する野草
text.official_en:
A rare herb from Pasithea. It has a
refreshing taste and is featured
heavily in legends of giants.
text.real_en: A rare herb from Pasithea that creates a distinctive cooling sensation in the mouth. It also appears in legends of giants.

text.jp:
好んで食べられる野菜
耕した畑から稀に収穫できる
蕾を収穫して食用にするのが定番
text.official_en:
A popular vegetable. While it is rarely
farmed, its buds are harvested for food.
text.real_en:
A popular vegetable occasionally
harvested from cultivated fields. Its buds
are the part usually eaten.

text.jp:
南部地方に自生する茸の一種
耕した畑から稀に収穫できる
クサリクの大好物
text.official_en:
A southern mushroom that is rarely farmed.
It is a known favorite of the kusarik.
text.real_en:
A southern mushroom sometimes
harvested from cultivated fields.
A favorite food of the Kusarik.

text.jp:
香気高く人気のある野草
耕した畑から稀に収穫できる
食用になるのは地下茎の部分
text.official_en:
A fragrant and popular wild herb that is
rarely farmed. Only the root stem is edible.
text.real_en:
A fragrant wild herb occasionally
harvested from cultivated fields.
Only its underground stem is edible.

text.jp:
硬い葉を持つ小振りな野草
耕した畑から稀に収穫できる
眠気覚ましの効果がある
text.official_en:
A small herb that is rarely farmed. Its
sturdy leaves are often used to help
with sleepiness.
text.real_en:
A small, stiff-leaved herb occasionally
harvested from cultivated fields.
It helps ward off drowsiness.

text.jp:
土塊のように見える藍藻の仲間
半透明で弾性に富んでおり、
他にない味わいを持つ
text.official_en:
A green-blue algae that appears to be a
lump of soil. It is translucent, highly elastic,
and unique in flavor.

text.jp:
人気のある高級な植物
樹皮を煮込むと甘い汁が得られ、
甘味料として利用される
text.official_en:
A popular, luxurious plant. The bark is
boiled to produce a high-quality sweetener.
text.real_en: A prized plant whose bark is boiled to produce sweet juice used as a sweetener.

text.jp:
オーマ地方に自生する高級野菜
最近まで知名度がなかった
塩害に強く、海辺でもよく育つ
text.official_en:
A luxury vegetable from the Ogmios region,
found near the sea. It is fairly new to
public markets.
text.real_en:
A prized vegetable native to Oma.
Little-known until recently, it tolerates
salt and grows well by the sea.

text.jp:
ダグザ北西部に自生する果物
祭りを彩る縁起物として知られる
甘い香りとは裏腹に果肉は辛い
text.official_en:
A spicy fruit with a sweet aroma. Grows in
northwest Dagda. It is commonly used as
a lucky charm.
text.real_en: A fruit native to northwestern Dagda, regarded as auspicious and used to decorate festivals. Its flesh is spicy despite its sweet aroma.

text.jp:
北ダグザ一帯に自生する菌類
炎のような外見が特徴
食べ過ぎると意識を失う
text.official_en:
A fungus of Northern Dagda with a
flame-like appearance. Eating too
much can lead to fainting.

text.jp:
風変りな味の砂漠の植物
海を越えた砂漠に自生している
非常に乾燥に強い
text.official_en:
A desert plant with an odd flavor. Found
only in deserts far across the sea. It is
highly drought-resistant.

text.jp:
個性的で希少な砂漠の植物
海を越えた砂漠に自生している
風で転がる姿が特徴的
text.official_en:
A unique plant that only grows in deserts
across the sea. Known for the way it
tumbles in the wind.

text.jp:
鮮やかな青色の果皮を持つ果物
高温で多湿の土地を好む
保存食としても人気が高い
text.official_en:
A vivid-blue fruit that thrives in hot, humid
climates. It is popular as a preserved food.

text.jp:
ダグザ中央に自生する果物
小さく赤い果実が蔓草に鈴なりに
実る姿が印象的
text.official_en:
A small red fruit common to central Dagda.
The way this fruit hangs from its vines
is impressive.

text.jp:
主にダグザ中央に自生する果物
果物としては珍しく、巨大になる
程に深い味わいになるという
text.official_en:
An unusual fruit that grows mainly in
central Dagda. Its flavor is known to
deepen as it grows in size.

text.jp:
主に深い森に自生する甘い香草
酒場の常連たちに人気のある
混酒を作るための材料
text.official_en:
A sweet herb that grows mainly in forests.
Often used to make mixed drinks, it is
favored by tavern regulars.

text.jp:
刺激的な風味を与える香草
酒場の常連たちに人気のある
混酒を作るための材料
text.official_en:
An herb known to add a sharp zing to
mixed drinks. It is a favored ingredient
of tavern patrons.

text.jp:
すっきりとした苦さを持つ香草
酒場の常連たちに人気のある
混酒を作るための材料
text.official_en:
An herb that adds a light, bitter zip to
mixed drinks. It is a favored ingredient
of tavern patrons.

text.jp:
複雑かつ玄妙な風味の香草
酒場の常連たちに人気のある
混酒を作るための材料
text.official_en:
An herb that adds a curiously complex
flavor to mixed drinks. Favored by
tavern patrons.

text.jp:
肉厚な貝殻から削り出された
細身で鋭い高品質な釣り針
主に釣りが好きな人が喜ぶ
text.official_en:
A piercing, high-quality fishhook carved
from thick seashell. Primarily enjoyed by
fishing enthusiasts.

text.jp:
交易により海外から持ち込まれた
かなりの時代を感じる書物
主に本が好きな人が喜ぶ
text.official_en:
An ancient book imported from a faraway
land. Primarily enjoyed by book lovers.
text.real_en: A rather old book brought from overseas through trade. Primarily enjoyed by book lovers.

text.jp:
珍しい水鳥の羽で造られた矢羽根
矢がまっすぐに飛ぶと人気が高い
主に弓が好きな人が喜ぶ
text.official_en:
Arrow quills forged from waterfowl feathers.
They improve accuracy. Primarily enjoyed
by archers.
text.real_en:
Arrow fletching made from rare
waterfowl feathers, prized for helping
arrows fly straight.

text.jp:
各地の家庭料理がまとめられた本
食に関わる者たちの垂涎の一冊
主に料理が好きな人が喜ぶ
text.official_en:
A collection of home-cooked meals from
around the world. Primarily enjoyed by
those who love to cook.

text.jp:
ダグザでは一般的な盤上遊戯
重厚で艶やかな高級材を用いた銘品
主に盤上遊戯が好きな人が喜ぶ
text.official_en:
A common Dagdan board game crafted
from high-quality wood. Primarily
enjoyed by board-game enthusiasts.

text.jp:
遥か東方にあるサイの国の茶葉
流通量が少なく希少性が高い品
主に飲み物が好きな人が喜ぶ
text.official_en:
Tea leaves from the land of Sai. It is a rare,
high-quality, and limited product. Primarily
enjoyed by those who love beverages.

text.jp:
カエルスで製造されている
女神も愛用する高品質な化粧水
主にお洒落が好きな人が喜ぶ
text.official_en:
This premium lotion from Caelus is rumored
to be used by goddesses. Primarily enjoyed
by fashion lovers.
text.real_en:
A high-quality cosmetic lotion made in
Caelus, used even by goddesses.
Primarily enjoyed by fashion lovers.

text.jp:
必要な品が一通り揃った
使い勝手の良さが人気の裁縫道具
主にお洒落が好きな人が喜ぶ
text.official_en:
A complete set of sewing essentials that are
incredibly easy to use. Primarily enjoyed by
fashion lovers.

text.jp:
大人の一抱えほどの太さがある
古い遺跡から持ち出された石柱
主に鍛錬が好きな人が喜ぶ
text.official_en:
A small, stone pillar found in an ancient
ruin. Primarily enjoyed by training
enthusiasts.
text.real_en:
A stone pillar from ancient ruins,
as thick as an adult can embrace.
Primarily enjoyed by training enthusiasts.

text.jp:
海の向こうの詩を一冊に集めた
土地ごとの文化が感じられる詩集
主に本が好きな人が喜ぶ
text.official_en:
A collection of poems from across the sea,
capturing the art of other cultures.
Primarily enjoyed by book lovers.

text.jp:
魔道の神スミルノスの飼う黒猫を
うまく再現した木彫りの置物
主に動物が好きな人が喜ぶ
text.official_en:
A beautiful wooden figure carved in the
likeness of Smyrnos's black cat.
Primarily enjoyed by animal lovers.

text.jp:
南ダグザ大陸にのみ分布する
といわれる珍しい植物の種
主に畑仕事が好きな人が喜ぶ
text.official_en:
A rare plant species said to be found 
only in Southern Dagda. Primarily
enjoyed by agriculture enthusiasts.
text.real_en:
Seeds of a rare plant said to grow
only in southern Dagda. Primarily enjoyed
by those who like working the fields.

text.jp:
ダ・ミナで作られたという
使いやすい彫刻刀の一式
主に芸術が好きな人が喜ぶ
text.official_en:
A set of easy-to-use carving knives
from Da Mina. Primarily enjoyed by
crafting enthusiasts.

text.jp:
摂取した子供の体を丈夫にする
お菓子のつくり方が書かれた本
主に甘い物が好きな人が喜ぶ
text.official_en:
A cookbook filled with recipes of nutritious
sweets that children would love. Primarily
enjoyed by those who love sweets.
text.real_en: A book of recipes for sweets that strengthen children's bodies. Primarily enjoyed by people who love sweets.

text.jp:
美しい花を描いた精緻な絵画
名画家が残した伝説の連作の一つ
主に絵画が好きな人が喜ぶ
text.official_en:
An intricate painting of flowers. Part of
a series by a master artist. Primarily
enjoyed by painting lovers.

text.jp:
切れ味のよい小振りな短剣
日常の様々な場面で役立つ
主に武器が好きな人が喜ぶ
text.official_en:
A small, versatile dagger. Useful in a variety
of everyday situations. Primarily enjoyed by
weapon lovers.

text.jp:
砂糖と香りのよい香辛料を
ふんだんに使った品のいい焼き菓子
主に甘い物が好きな人が喜ぶ
text.official_en:
Elegant baked goods made with sugar and
fragrant spices. Primarily enjoyed by
those who love sweets.

text.jp:
とある士官学校の中で巻き起こる
奇怪な事件を描いた冒険譚

A device that fires massive arrows.

An attack that uses the animal's powerful

An attack that uses the animal's body
weight to trample foes.

英雄マハマドゥが振るった力
力<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>

An arm of the legendary Mahadu, now
fused to a new hero, Theodora of Saramis.
Grants Str<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>

Theodora's right arm holds immense
power once wielded by the hero
Mahamadou. Grants Str<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>

全てを破壊し尽くす魔神の力
力<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>

Once a tool for good, Theodora's arm now
uses its dark power to maim and destroy.
Grants Str<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>

the underworld, bearing a demon god's

冥界の底から響く昏い旋律

Leda's vihuela. With every note, horrid

Grants Res<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>

the underworld. Its dark melody echoes

Obsidian steeped in deeper darkness.
A dark melody echoes from the depths
of the underworld. Grants Res<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>

タリムーンの持つ不思議な羅針盤

帝国の中心地アマルテア地方の

A map noting major locations in Amalthea,
the empire's central region containing
Dagsion.
text.real_en:
A traveler's map of major locations in
Amalthea, the empire's central region
and home to Imperial Capital Dagsion.

text.jp:
帝都の西に位置し実に表情豊かな
自然地形が存在するランバス地方の
主要な場所を記した旅人の地図
text.official_en:
A map noting major locations in Lambath,
the region west of the capital.
text.real_en:
A traveler's map of the major places
in the Lambuth region west of the capital,
known for its varied natural landscapes.

text.jp:
帝都の南東に位置し多くの人々が
営みを行うエレクトラ地方の
主要な場所を記した旅人の地図
text.official_en:
A map noting major locations in Elektra,
the bustling region to the southeast of
the capital.

text.jp:
帝都の北東に位置し海を越えた
交易なども行うカスタリア地方の
主要な場所を記した旅人の地図
text.official_en:
A map noting major locations in Castalia,
the vibrant trading region to the northeast
of the capital.

text.jp:
帝都の北に位置する山岳地帯に
逞しい人々が暮らすタレイア地方の
主要な場所を記した旅人の地図
text.official_en:
A map noting major locations in Thaleia,
the rugged, mountainous region north of
the capital.

text.jp:
帝都の遥か北西に位置し自然の
脅威と共存するソリダス地方の
主要な場所を記した旅人の地図
text.official_en:
A map noting major locations in Solidus,
far to the northwest, where people coexist
with natural threats.

text.jp:
ダグザ大陸の西端に位置し未開の
場所が多く残るバシテア地方の
主要な場所を記した旅人の地図
text.official_en:
A map noting major locations in Pasithea,
the largely uncharted region to the far west
of Dagsion.
text.real_en:
A traveler's map of major locations in
Pasithea, largely unexplored and at the
western edge of the Dagda continent.

text.jp:
帝都の遠く南西に位置し豊かな
森林を擁するブラクシテア地方の
主要な場所を記した旅人の地図
text.official_en:
A map noting major locations in Braxithea,
the lush forest region far to the southwest
of the capital.

text.jp:
帝都の南に位置し穏やかな
空気の流れるメリアス地方の
主要な場所を記した旅人の地図
text.official_en:
A map noting major locations in Melias,
the region south of Dagsion where gentle
breezes flow.

text.jp:
帝都の遠く南に位置し大きな悲劇の
舞台にもなったサヴェロン地方の
主要な場所を記した旅人の地図
text.official_en:
A map noting major locations in Saveilon
to the far south of the capital, known for
its tragic history.
text.real_en:
A traveler's map of the Saveron region
far south of the capital, where a great
tragedy once unfolded.
